context: CYP51 (sterol 14-alpha-demethylase) substitution in wheat pathogens; a documented DMI-azole resistance mechanism.
notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW: Y137F is documented in Zymoseptoria tritici (wheat septoria) and as Y136F in Blumeria graminis (powdery mildew) - NOT in Puccinia (wheat rust). Rusts are not primarily controlled by DMI azoles. Either (a) reframe this demo as wheat septoria, which keeps the literature support, or (b) pick a genuine Puccinia target. Residue numbering and accession must be confirmed against the chosen organism before this counts as a positive control.
source: Cools & Fraaije, CYP51 variant literature in Z. tritici
